tellings.quote: There are two types of summoning that can be done that we've proven works and we're still working with.

plain: A former helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he once flew a recovered UFO, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that there are two ways to summon unidentified craft: one using machines and one using people. Barber says both have been proven to work and that his group is still working with them. If true, it would mean people can call these craft on purpose.
